title: index.js: CLI Entry Point
description: Shebang-enabled Node script that greets by name from process.argv, with structured JSON output and course exception pattern.

steps.description: Shebang: #!/usr/bin/env node makes file executable as CLI command.
Comment and argument: explains purpose, gets name from process.argv[2] or defaults to world.
Output: logs structured JSON with greeting and CS357 identifier.
Error handling: course exception pattern with console.error for debug info and clean exit.
